heading: Repealed. Oct. 30, 1951, ch. 631, title II, § 207(a)(6), 65 Stat. 682

notes.text: Sections, act Aug. 13, 1946, ch. 957, title IX, §§ 931, 932, 60 Stat. 1028, related to annual and sick leave for officers and employees in the Foreign Service. See section 6301 et seq. of Title 5, Government Organization and Employees.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Repeal effective Jan. 6, 1952, see act Oct. 30, 1951, ch. 631, § 209, 65 Stat. 683.
